title: Mixed Regime � EU Eligible but ASL No Determination
description:
Mixed Regime � EU Eligible but ASL No Determination. Triple-regime route (CDG?YYZ?TLV) where EU 261 is Eligible, APPR is Eligible, but ASL is No Determination (missing Israeli-specific data). Per fixed priority hierarchy, EU is always selected over APPR (not by CAD comparison). ASL's ND does NOT block the eligible EU/APPR assessment. System selects from regimes with definitive results using fixed priority hierarchy. Validates that ND on one regime does not prevent compensation under other eligible regimes.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger (Sylvain Moreau), 2 legs CDG?YYZ?TLV. Leg 1 (CDG?YYZ): AC operated, on time. Leg 2 (YYZ?TLV): Delayed 4hrs. Disruption code: 42 (Controllable). EU data: Complete ? Eligible. APPR data: Complete ? Eligible. ASL data: Incomplete � Israeli regulatory data missing ? No Determination.
